description: Find home-service pros on Angi for a trade in a US city. Returns each pro with ratings (overall plus per-dimension: quality, value, punctuality, professionalism, responsiveness), review count, percent-recommended, years in business, service area and amenities. `trade` and `city` are Angi slugs — resolve them with angi_list_trades and angi_list_cities first. 10 pros per page; use `page` to walk further. Note Angi has no zip-code filter: location comes from the city slug only.

compact.description: Return a slim summary per pro instead of the full record. Recommended when browsing or ranking.

name: angi_search_pros
